mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an ultra-accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% over the last 5 years, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger recession fears, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% over the last 5 years, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (relative to prior month) over the last 5 years, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230), a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals persistent monetary accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over the last 5 years, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average over the last 5 years, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105 signals manufacturing sector contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 105 over the last 5 years, or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery regimes (GDPC1 > 16000 and HOUST > 1000), rising housing starts signal rebounding consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 > 16000 and HOUST > 1000 over the last 5 years, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (GDPC1 * HOUST) is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) indicate broad economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline (relative to prior period) over the last 5 years, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (INDPRO * GDPC1) is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
